hashing.treeDefinition: For every regular file and symlink below the root (do not follow symlinks), form UTF-8 records F\0<relative-posix-path>\0<four-digit-octal-mode>\0<file-sha256>\n or L\0<relative-posix-path>\0<link-target>\n. Sort complete records by byte order, concatenate, and SHA-256. Directory records are omitted.
